component: Intel Core i9 / i7 / i5 (13th & 14th Gen)
symptomsEn: Game crashes during shader compilation (Oodle / Unreal Engine), BSOD 0x00000139 or 0x00000124 under load.
symptomsMs: Game 'crash' ketika compile shader (Unreal Engine), BSOD 0x00000139 atau 0x00000124 ketika beban tinggi.
fixEn: Update motherboard BIOS immediately to microcode 0x12B or newer. Enforce 'Intel Default Settings' profile in BIOS.
fixMs: Kemas kini BIOS motherboard serta-merta ke versi microcode 0x12B atau terkini. Tetapkan profil 'Intel Default Settings'.

symptomsEn: Burning plastic smell, GPU fans ramp to 100% with black screen, pin discoloration at 16-pin connector.
symptomsMs: Bau plastik terbakar, kipas GPU pusing 100% dan skrin hitam, warna pin soket 16-pin berubah kehitaman.
fixEn: Ensure at least 35mm straight clearance before bending cable. Push connector until latch clicks fully shut with zero gap.
fixMs: Pastikan wayar lurus sekurang-kurangnya 35mm sebelum dibengkokkan. Tolak penyambung sehingga klip berbunyi klik tanpa jurang.

flawNameMs: Voltan Lebih SoC EXPO Merosakkan Pin Soket
symptomsEn: Motherboard fails to POST after EXPO memory profile enabled, visible burn mark on CPU contact pads.
symptomsMs: Motherboard gagal POST selepas aktifkan profil EXPO, kesan terbakar pada tapak tembaga CPU.
fixEn: Update motherboard BIOS to AGESA 1.0.0.7c or later. Confirms SoC voltage is hard-locked to a safe maximum of 1.30V.
fixMs: Kemas kini BIOS motherboard ke AGESA 1.0.0.7c atau terkini untuk mengehadkan voltan SoC kepada maksimum 1.30V yang selamat.

symptomsEn: Drive suddenly becomes read-only, Windows refuses to write files or crashes on boot with INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE.
symptomsMs: Pemacu SSD tiba-tiba jadi 'read-only', Windows gagal tulis fail atau crash dengan INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE.
fixEn: If drive is running firmware 3B2QGXA7, immediately update to 5B2QGXA7 via Samsung Magician before 0E error count increases.
fixMs: Jika SSD menggunakan firmware 3B2QGXA7, kemas kini segera ke 5B2QGXA7 melalui perisian Samsung Magician sebelum rosak.

flawNameMs: Sambungan Internet Terputus 2-3 Saat Secara Berkala
symptomsEn: Ethernet drops connection for 2 to 3 seconds during Discord calls or online gaming, event log shows e2fnexpress errors.
symptomsMs: Internet terputus selama 2 hingga 3 saat ketika panggilan Discord atau main game online, log paparkan ralat e2fnexpress.
fixEn: Open Device Manager > Network Adapters > Intel Controller Properties > Advanced > Disable 'Energy Efficient Ethernet' (EEE).
fixMs: Buka Device Manager > Network Adapters > Properties Intel LAN > Advanced > Matikan (Disable) 'Energy Efficient Ethernet' (EEE).

flawNameMs: Sangkut (Stutter) Berulang Akibat Cip fTPM AMD
symptomsEn: Random 1-2 second audio buzzing and mouse freeze while doing normal desktop tasks in Windows 11.
symptomsMs: Audio berbunyi berdengung dan tetikus tersangkut selama 1-2 saat secara rawak dalam Windows 11.
fixEn: Update motherboard BIOS to version with AGESA 1.2.0.7 or newer, which eliminates SPI flash transaction latency.
fixMs: Kemas kini BIOS motherboard ke versi AGESA 1.2.0.7 atau lebih baharu untuk menghapuskan kelewatan transaksi cip fTPM.

component: All Modular Power Supplies (Corsair, Seasonic, EVGA)
symptomsEn: Instant pop, smoke, or dead motherboard / SSD when turning on PC with cables from a different power supply.
symptomsMs: Bunyi letup kecil, asap, atau motherboard terus mati apabila guna kabel modular dari PSU jenama berbeza.
fixEn: NEVER mix modular PSU cables between different brands or generations. Modular PSU pinouts are NOT standardized at the PSU end.
fixMs: JANGAN sesekali campur kabel modular antara jenama berbeza. Susunan pin di bahagian kotak PSU tidak standard.
